Built from scratch, in-house, with no third-party tools and no compromises, BortoCall gives organizations the architecture to communicate, collaborate, and operate, fully within their own perimeter, under their own law, invisible to everyone else.Its two flagship products, Relay, a secure enterprise instant messaging platform, and Confy, a sovereign HD video conferencing solution, are deployed on-premises, or on a sovereign cloud, giving each organization the deployment flexibility its infrastructure demands and the sovereignty its data deserves.Since its commercial launch in April 2026, BortoCall has onboarded institutions and enterprises, secured a strategic partnership with Djezzy, Algeria's leading telecom operator, and is actively exploring expantion opportunities across the MENA region and international markets.The conviction is simple and non-negotiable: communication infrastructure should belong to those who depend on it. BortoCall is building that future, one sovereign deployment at a time.

Through APIs, Carevision integrates into partners’ mobile apps, kiosks, digital clinics, and teleconsultation platforms—making intelligent screening accessible wherever people receive care. It is the foundation everything else at Ctruh sits on, and it is what makes an immersive experience as easy to distribute as a URL. For enterprises, this collapses the single largest barrier to adoption: distribution. A customer does not install anything, and a sales team does not ask them to.VersaAI is our generative and on-device AI layer, converting text, images, and video into production-ready 3D assets. What has historically required a 3D artist and weeks of modelling time becomes a generated asset in minutes, at a fraction of the cost. VersaAI is what makes immersive content economically viable at enterprise scale rather than a one-off marketing expense, it turns 3D from a bespoke commission into a repeatable pipeline.Together, these two layers form a complete stack: generate the asset, render it anywhere, and let anyone build with it.Industries we serveCtruh is horizontal infrastructure, and our deployments span:Real estate and construction: virtual walkthroughs, pre-construction visualisation, digital sales galleries for developers and giga-projectsRetail and e-commerce: 3D product configurators, virtual storefronts, try-before-you-buy experiencesAutomotive: online configurators, virtual showrooms, dealer and aftersales visualisationManufacturing and industrial: digital twins, plant and equipment visualisation, remote inspectionEnergy and heavy industry: asset visualisation, operational training, safety simulationEducation and training: immersive learning modules, procedural and skills training at scaleTravel, hospitality and tourism:property and destination previews, heritage and cultural experiencesCredentialsFounded in 2023 and headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Ctruh holds three patents in core XR technology and is backed by a seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures , Avinya Ventures and India Accelerator co-leading. Our team of 50 spans engineering, AI/ML, 3D design, and go-to-market. Ctruh featured on Shark Tank India Season 5, and we are currently raising a Series A to scale international deployment.Why now, and why Saudi ArabiaVision 2030 has made the Kingdom one of the fastest technology-adopting markets in the world, with giga-projects, retail, and industrial sectors all actively investing in immersive and digital-twin capability. Our engagement with Saudi Aramco confirmed both the appetite and the fit. LEAP 2026 is our formal entry point into the region, and the infrastructure layer we have built is precisely what a market building entire cities from scratch needs to visualise, sell, and operate them.

description: تُعد شركة ديار الشرق الأوسط شريكاً تقنياً ريادياً ومُكامِلاً معتمداً للأنظمة الرقمية للجهات الحكومية والمؤسسات الكبرى. ومنذ تأسيسها في عام 1980، أسست الشركة إرثاً عريقاً يمتد لأكثر من أربعة عقود من التميز والريادة الإقليمية في قطاع تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات. ومنذ ترسيخ حضورنا في قلب المملكة العربية السعودية، اتخذنا من رؤية المملكة 2030 نبراساً لمسيرتنا، ملتزمين بدورنا كمحرك رئيسي للتحول الرقمي الوطني ومساهم فاعل في توطين التقنيات العالمية لبناء اقتصاد رقمي آمن ومستدام.وتوفر الشركة، من خلال عملياتها الممتدة في الشرق الأوسط وواسع نطاقها التشغيلي، قدرات متكاملة تشمل: حلول تقنية المعلومات والاتصالات، الذكاء الاصطناعي، تطوير التطبيقات، الأمن السيبراني، الخدمات المُدارة، والتحول الرقمي الشامل.نعتمد في تنفيذ هذه القيم على قاعدة معرفية صلبة تضم أكثر من 3,500 متخصص من أصحاب الخبرة التقنية. كما نفخر بكوننا ضمن المؤسسات القليلة الحاصلة على تصنيف CMMI Level 5، أرفع مستوى عالمي لنضج عمليات تطوير البرمجيات، بجانب حزمة متكاملة من شهادات الأيزو العالمية ISO 9001, 20000, 27001, 22301 وبصفتنا شريكاً مرخصاً من هيئة الحكومة الرقمية (DGA)، فإننا نضمن توافق مشاريعنا مع المعايير والبروتوكولات الوطنية الصارمة.إن القيمة المضافة التي نعدكم بها تنبع من سجل حافل بالنجاحات الاستراتيجية مع كبرى الجهات الحكومية وشبه الحكومية والكيانات العملاقة في المملكة عبر مختلف القطاعات الحيوية، بما في ذلك القطاع المالي، والنفط والغاز، والتعليم، والصحة, والاتصالات. ومن خلال تحالفاتنا الاستراتيجية مع أكثر من 500 شريك تقني عالمي، فإننا نمتلك قدرة استثنائية على دمج الابتكا��ات الدولية مع الفهم العميق لمتطلبات السوق المحلي، لتقديم بنية تحتية مرنة وقابلة للتوسع تخدم تطلعاتكم وتضمن ريادتكم الرقمية الدائمة.

It has one of the largest wireless networks by coverage in Saudi Arabia, as well as the region, and one of the widest FTTH networks, in addition to one of the largest data center systems worldwide.The Company’s network comprises its own infrastructure and those of Bayanat al-Oula and SNFN. This is the Kingdom’s newest fiber-optic network, with access to all major cities and more than 58,060 km of roads. The network has been expanded to connect to neighboring countries including Yemen, the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait and Jordan.Mobily has been listed on Saudi Arabia’s Tadawul stock exchange since 2004. name: Sary Ismail
description: AskSary Studio is an independent AI technology company based in Bahrain, building advanced AI platforms across intelligent productivity, generative creation and governed autonomous systems with our latest platform, AskSary Studio being unveiled at LEAP AskSary Studio, is a unified multi-model AI creation and productivity environment designed to take users from conversation to finished work without moving between disconnected applications. It brings leading AI models together with cross-device persistent memory, knowledge retrieval, real-time voice, image and video generation, advanced image editing, music and podcast creation, presentation generation, coding and AI-assisted 3D game development within a single platform.AskSary's Studio creative environment extends beyond generation. AskSary Studio provides a multitrack production workspace where images, video, voice, music, text and generated assets can be created, assembled and edited together. Specialist environments for image editing, music, video and development remain connected through persistent workspaces, allowing users to move between activities without losing their working state.An application-wide AskSary Studio Guide adds a conversational control layer across the platform. Users can describe what they want in natural language or by voice, and the Guide can explain features, navigate between tools, prepare prompts, configure forms and settings, and assist with multi-step creative workflows. For paid generation operations, users remain in control through transparent credit estimates and approval before execution.AskSary Studio also includes a project-aware AI development environment capable of opening and understanding large codebases, filtering unnecessary project noise, searching across files, proposing coordinated multi-file changes, presenting reviewable changes before they are applied, and rendering live application previews. Users can work with individual files or complete projects while retaining control over proposed edits.Persistent workspaces allow multiple activities to coexist across the platform, while editable project state and cloud storage allow creative work to be resumed rather than reduced to one-off generated outputs. This connects conversation, generation, editing, development and production into a continuous workflow.Together, these capabilities position AskSary Studio not simply as a multi-model chatbot or collection of AI tools, but as a persistent AI workspace for creation, development and production - where models, agents, files, projects and specialist creative environments can work together while the user remains in control.Alongside AskSary Studio, we are developing ARIA - Autonomous Resilience Intelligence Architecture, an AI-native security operations platform designed around governed autonomy and sovereign deployment.ARIA combines live system and network telemetry, AI Security Posture Management, identity and session intelligence, attack-path reasoning, evidence analysis, automated scanning, security reporting and autonomous response within a voice-native spatial command environment. It can operate across connected enterprise infrastructure while maintaining detailed records of its observations, decisions, actions, approvals and human interventions.At the centre of ARIA is its Trust Ladder. Rather than giving an AI unrestricted authority, individual capabilities progress from human approval through assisted and autonomous operation based on measured outcomes. Authority can be promoted only within defined governance boundaries, failures can immediately reduce autonomy, and critical actions remain subject to explicit controls. The AI cannot simply grant itself greater authority.ARIA maintains a persistent operational memory, autonomously recording security findings, scans, decisions, actions, approvals and human interventions to create an auditable history of how the system has observed and responded to its environment.ARIA is also designed for local, on-premises and hybrid AI deployment, allowing organizations with strict data-sovereignty requirements to keep sensitive operational telemetry within their own environment while using local models where required.Both platforms reflect the same philosophy: we are not interested in simply placing an AI chatbot on top of existing software. We are exploring what software becomes when intelligence, memory, reasoning, voice and autonomous action are treated as fundamental parts of the architecture.Alongside AskSary and ARIA, we are also developing an autonomous media and editorial platform for BFT Media in Bahrain, who approached us directly after discovering our work. The platform is designed to automate the content lifecycle from intelligence gathering and multilingual editorial processing through to AI-generated media, scheduling and cross-platform publishing. Rather than functioning as a collection of isolated AI tools, the system coordinates these capabilities as a continuous operational workflow.Across our platforms, the philosophy is the same: we are not interested in simply placing an AI chatbot on top of existing software. We are exploring what software becomes when intelligence, memory, reasoning, voice and autonomous action are treated as fundamental parts of the architecture.From creative AI and software development to autonomous media operations and sovereign, governed cybersecurity, we are building systems designed to make artificial intelligence more capable, more intuitive and more accountable.

name: Smart TechOne
description: Smart TechOne is the technology and innovation arm of the HRL Engineering, one of Pakistan's established engineering and infrastructure groups. Registered as an STZA Zone Enterprise, the company applies that engineering lineage to the digital layer of the city. Smart TechOne leads digital transformation & innovation for Capital Smart City and Lahore Smart City across the full delivery chain. We specify and deploy the sensing and connectivity layer, we build the software that runs on top of it, and we operate the command centre daily. Most smart city suppliers deliver a single product line: a meter, a camera, a parking sensor or a dashboard. The city then ends up administering forty disconnected systems. Smart TechOne begins instead with one platform and selects hardware that fits it.That platform is SmartCity OS, ECHO, and its centre is a live 4D Digital Twin of the city. Every pole, meter, plot, building, lift, valve and vehicle exists in the twin as an object with history, state and behaviour, streaming from more than 25 operational modules across energy, water, sewerage, environment, buildings, safety, mobility and town planning. Because every module reports into the same model, a single event can drive several systems at once. A fire alarm releases the nearest barrier, recalls the lift, pushes the camera feed to the command centre, routes the fire vehicle and notifies the block. Operators replay incidents, and simulate an action such as closing a valve or releasing a sector before committing to it. ECHO AI runs a seven-day predictive horizon over the same twin for demand forecasting, leak and anomaly detection, computer vision and maintenance prediction. Critically, the city is planned on the model that operates it, so an approved plot, a planted avenue and a sewer segment remain the same record from proposal to sensor.The stack is proven in an occupied city before it is offered to the next. Each module is commissioned and hardened in live operation at Capital Smart City and Lahore Smart City, run from the Command Centre and developed at the Silicon Village Incubation Center. Delivered outcomes are measured in revenue assurance, operating cost, public safety, asset lifecycle and planning integrity, against a 99.97% platform availability target and support in 7 languages. Smart TechOne is available to municipal authorities, master developers and public sector clients as a complete platform or module by module, with an operate and support model in which our teams run the platform rather than hand over a system and a manual. Meet us at LEAP 2026, Riyadh.

name: Waspito
description: Waspito ("Health Without a Step") is a three-sided platform — patients, providers, payers — where an African health AI orchestrates care delivery and financing across Central and West Africa. It fixes healthcare at the point of payment: patients get care with zero out-of-pocket pre-financing, providers are paid instantly on claim validation, and payers gain real-time control over fraud and leakage. Sitting on the live transaction flow is AHIM, our African Health Intelligence Model — a clinical LLM fine-tuned on proprietary, closed-loop patient–provider–payer data that adjudicates medical necessity in eight seconds at $0.002, versus 45 minutes and $3.50 for a human reviewer. With ~1.1M patients, ~3,250 providers, and 300,000+ consultations, Waspito is live and revenue-generating in Cameroon and Côte d'Ivoire, with insurer partners including Be-Life and Activa. Because every new market feeds AHIM, Waspito is portable deep-tech health infrastructure — built to scale across Africa and into other emerging markets.
